entry.title: FBI Reports Decline in Oregon Crime, With Violent Crime Continuing to Fall in 2026
entry.summary: Violent crime in Oregon fell 7.9% in 2025, while property crime dropped 12.1%, according to the FBI. Preliminary figures show violent crime continued to decline through August 2026, falling approximately 16% compared to the same period last year.

entry.title: Oregon Unemployment Insurance Tax Rates To Drop In 2027, Saving Employers Up To $172.7 Million
entry.summary: Oregon employers could save up to $172.7 million in 2027 as the state lowers Unemployment Insurance tax rates. The taxable wage base will increase, while Paid Leave Oregon's contribution rate remains unchanged at 1 percent.
